subject: Junior civil designer or draftsperson enquiry, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello TGVK team,

Your careers page says you are always looking for engineers, designers and draftsmen and asks for a CV and cover letter, so this is a speculative enquiry rather than a reply to an advert.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.

The stormwater, paving and retaining wall design your civil team does is the work I want to grow in. My software experience is from study, not commercial production, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Would you consider me for a junior civil designer or draftsperson role, now or later?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: Your careers page says you are always looking for engineers, designers and draftsmen and invites a CV and formal cover letter, so this is a speculative enquiry about a junior civil designer or civil draftsperson role with your team in Mulgrave.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records.

Stormwater design, paving and retaining walls are the kind of civil work I want to build a career in. My software experience is from study rather than commercial production, so I would start at junior level and learn your drafting standards. I am based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about any opening, now or later.
